summary: CPerezz 分析在 zkEVM 之后的无状态节点世界里，EIP-8141 内存池策略如何与不持有完整状态的节点相处。lightclient 与 fvictorio_nan 把账户抽象 11 年历史的链接树更新到 2026 年。ACDT #76 确认 bal-devnet-3 下周上线，glamsterdam-devnet-0 目标 4 月 15 日，包含 BAL 与 ePBS。

items.title: ethresear.ch：从无状态视角看 frame 交易
items.note: （CPerezz）04:57：zkEVM 用证明验证替代重新执行后，节点参与共识不再需要约 280 GB 状态，只有 builder、RPC 与搜索者因业务需要保留状态；文章讨论 AA 与 EIP-8141 内存池策略在这种节点上如何运作。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Frame Transactions Through a Statelessness Lens
items.note_en: (CPerezz), 04:57: once zkEVMs replace re-execution with proof verification, nodes no longer need about 280 GB of state to take part in consensus, leaving only builders, RPC providers and searchers holding state; the post examines how AA and EIP-8141 mempool strategies work for such nodes.

items.title: 新增 ERC：Smart Batching
items.note: （oxshaman）提交：为智能账户定义可组合的批处理编码，每个参数声明执行时如何取值（字面量、staticcall 或余额查询）以及须满足的约束，实现动态交易。
items.note_en: (oxshaman), submitted: a composable batch encoding for smart accounts where each parameter declares how to get its value at execution time (literal, staticcall or balance query) and what constraints it must meet, enabling dynamic transactions.

keywords_en: Frame transactions through a statelessness lens
an 11 year account abstraction link tree
summary_en: CPerezz analyzed how EIP-8141 mempool strategies interact with stateless nodes that no longer hold full state in a post zkEVM world. lightclient and fvictorio_nan updated the link tree of 11 years of account abstraction history through 2026. ACDT #76 set bal-devnet-3 for next week and glamsterdam-devnet-0 for April 15 with BALs and ePBS.
